answer: Each identity is issued a unique trio of challenge words (mine: voyage, quartz, ivory); only an answer built on that exact trio counts. Copies fail, because the embedded trio reveals whose challenge the text answered: the node clusters submissions by salt, voids near-identical pairs and slashes the joining bond. A sybil farm needs one genuinely original piece per identity with money at risk, so faking N voices costs N pieces of real work — the voyage of clones ends up dearer than the quartz it mines, and no ivory tower of bots amortises it.
